model.title: A bill to provide for an extension of the legislative authority of the National Emergency Medical Services Memorial Foundation to establish a commemorative work in the District of Columbia and its environs.
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Christopher Coons (D-DE)

summary.text: The bill would extend the National Emergency Medical Services Memorial Foundation's authority to build a commemorative monument in Washington, D.C. and surrounding areas honoring emergency medical services personnel and their service.
